title: Enderby & District Museum and Archives

services.name: Walking Tour
services.desc: Our Historical Walking Tour of Enderby contains historical information and photos of heritage buildings in downtown Enderby. You can pick up a copy of the brochure in the museum or the tourist information centre and take a self-guided tour of the community. You will also find interpretive signs illustrating the development of the community along the Jim Watt Heritage Riverwalk. The walk begins at the tourist information centre and ends at Riverside Park. The Enderby & District Museum & Archives Society acknowledges that we live, work, play and grow within traditional Secwepemc First Nation
